mainEntity.name: Who is Thomas Prommer and what does he do?

acceptedAnswer.text: Thomas Prommer is a technology and AI advisor and hybrid athlete with more than 20 years of experience leading engineering and technology strategy. He previously served as Global SVP of Engineering at Adidas, Chief Information Officer at Sweetgreen, and President, Technology at Huge. He founded We The Flywheel, where he advises leaders on AI strategy, platform engineering, digital transformation, and technology due diligence.

We The Flywheel is a global sports media network, AI consultancy, and product studio, which Thomas Prommer founded and leads as Group CEO. It is also described as an agentic-led, AI-first digital product and consulting studio. Flywheel Motion is one of its products.

mainEntity.name: What is Thomas Prommer's point of view on agentic or AI-native operations?

acceptedAnswer.text: He treats AI as a production system with a human in the loop. Agents do the heavy lifting and people own the judgment. Every use of AI must have a measurable outcome. He also argues for crediting outcomes over tools, and for embedded AI squads instead of a central Center of Excellence.

mainEntity.name: How can a founder or a podcast booker contact or book him?

acceptedAnswer.text: Use the contact form on prommer.net, which has inquiry types including Speaking Engagement, Press & Media and Partnership Opportunity. He can also be reached on LinkedIn. For interviews, speaking engagements, or press inquiries, the press page says to reach out directly. A 60-minute advisory call can also be booked.
